title: Impact of Escalating Hawker Stall Rentals on Food Affordability
what_it_is: Impact of Escalating Hawker Stall Rentals on Food Affordability

sections.label: No reserve rent tenders
sections.summary: NEA sets no reserve rent or minimum bid price, and a Marine Parade Central tender drew over 40 bids with top five above $8,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: NEA does not set any reserve rent or minimum bid price for these tenders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The recent tender for the cooked food stall at Marine Parade Central Hawker Centre attracted over 40 bids.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The bids were quite competitive, with the top five bids above $8,000.

sections.label: Cooked food stall tender prices
sections.summary: Median successful tender price was about $1,800 in 2023, one in five stalls awarded at or below $500, and rent was under 10% of operating costs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The median successful tender price for cooked food stalls across hawker centres was about $1,800 in 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: About one in five cooked food stalls were also awarded at tender prices at or below $500 in 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Based on NEA's survey, on average, rental forms less than 10% of operating costs for stallholders, compared to raw materials and manpower which accounted for 56% and 20% of their operating costs respectively in 2022.

sections.label: Median rent of non-subsidised stalls
sections.summary: The median monthly rent of a non-subsidised cooked food stall is about $1,250 and has stayed at this level since 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: As a result of the various measures, the median monthly rent of a non-subsidised cooked food stall across our hawker centres is about $1,250 and it has remained at this level since 2015.

sections.label: Higher bids and market rent
sections.summary: Some may bid higher to secure stalls at popular locations, and only about 4% of cooked food stores pay rent above assessed market rent.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: While there are no minimum bid price restrictions, some may submit higher bids in order to secure the stalls at more popular locations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: And let me just also mention that only about 4% of cooked food stores in hawker centres today are paying rent at above the assessed market rent.
